cn.t: Francesca D'Uva earns praise for her inventive blend of stand-up and musical comedy, transforming personal grief into an engaging theatrical experience that connects with audiences through humor and emotional honesty.

vr.q: I thought this was a fantastic performance — there's like an art to the way Francesca delivers her material.
